list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026
method: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it. Every guide below is written in our own words from that list and the sources named beside it. GTA VI launches 19 November 2026, so where early reports say an unlock method is not yet confirmed, the guide says so instead of guessing. No guide text is copied from another guide.

sources.name: Official PS5 trophy list, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI (official site and trailers)

roadmap.title: Play the story, chapters 1 to 4 and the finale
roadmap.text: Finish every story mission in order. This earns all 17 story trophies: the opening mission, the four chapter trophies, the final mission, the seven named story missions and the five contact finales. Story trophies cannot be missed — you must finish the story — but early reports say there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

roadmap.title: The one missable: meditate before Chapter 1 ends
roadmap.text: Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy early reports flag as missable: one of its 18 meditation spots — Lucia's balcony — is only available in Chapter 1. Meditate there before you finish the chapter, then sweep the other 17 spots as you explore Leonida.

roadmap.title: Work toward 100% completion
roadmap.text: A Long Road (gold) wants 100% completion, the game's own checklist of story, activities, stranger strands, collectibles and exploration. Play the activities and stranger strands as they appear instead of leaving them all for the end — most of the list's counts feed this percentage. Check the in-game stats screen between sessions to see what is left.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and counts
roadmap.text: Finish the counting trophies: 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida explored, all 8 garage properties bought and 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. These are pure totals — chip away at them while you travel and they finish on their own.

roadmap.title: Activities, combat and free-roam mop-up
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 locations and 20 different races, pull off 250 stunts, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game and a bowling game, hunt Bret's unique animal, rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and one illegal operation per gang, and hit the money totals: $250,000 of marked bills laundered and $100,000 spent in shops.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is nothing extra to do for it — it is the finish line, not a task.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as your finish line, not a task: follow the roadmap stages in order and it arrives on its own. Expect a long road: early reports put the platinum at around 200 hours, with no online trophies and no difficulty trophies in the way.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy is unmissable — it unlocks automatically when the mission ends and the story moves on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by finishing every story mission in it. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that never comes back: the balcony meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing every story mission in it. Both Lucia and Jason are playable from around here, which is when most of the open-world activities open up — a good moment to start the activity and collectible counts in the roadmap.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by finishing every story mission in it. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks automatically when the chapter closes, and it cannot be missed as long as you finish the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing every story mission in it. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale — once it pops, only the final mission stands between you and the gold for finishing the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. It is the story's ending, so the trophy unlocks automatically when the mission ends — but keep a manual save from before the finale: early reports say there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is your only way back to replay the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Story missions cannot be missed, but there is no mission replay reported, so keep a manual save at the start of the chapter if you want to replay it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Heist missions are story beats, so this one cannot be missed as long as you finish the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Like every story-mission trophy, it cannot be missed — finishing the story earns it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Keep playing the main missions in order and this one arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the Vice City International Airport. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends, like every other story-mission trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Story missions cannot be missed, so just keep pushing the main story forward.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist of story, activities, stranger missions, collectibles and exploration. This is the longest grind in the list and the biggest single chunk of the platinum, so do not leave it for last: work through the roadmap stages and the percentage climbs with them. The in-game stats screen tracks your percentage, so check it between sessions to see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. Stunts rack up naturally while you drive hard between objectives, so do not grind them early: play the story and free-roam first, then check your count and mop up the rest with a fast car and long jumps. Any stunt the game registers counts, and repeats count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — a single try at each is enough, you do not have to win or finish anything. Open the activities list in-game, work down it one by one, and tick each off as you go. If one type will not register, try a different venue for the same activity.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so take them one at a time: learn the target pattern on a first run, then push for the gold threshold on the next. You can retry any challenge as often as you like, and golds are per-challenge, so there is no penalty for doing them in any order.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line first — a clean run beats a fast, crashing one — then race to win. A win at a location counts once; losing costs nothing but the retry.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types and venues, and note which you have already won so you do not repeat one by accident. Races you win while working on other trophies count too.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing game — hook, tire the fish out, reel it in without snapping the line — so watch Cal's pace and beat his catch rather than rushing your own. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick the shortest game you find first; completion, not a high score, is what counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Contact finales unlock as you finish that character's mission chain, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Like every story trophy it cannot be missed — just follow Andy's missions to their end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Contact finales unlock as you finish that character's mission chain, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Follow Kenton's missions to their end and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Contact finales unlock as you finish that character's mission chain, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Follow Billy's missions to their end and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map as you explore — stop for every one you pass, since each strand is a short chain of missions. Eight finished strands is the target; you can do more than eight, and strands found late in the story still count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Contact finales unlock as you finish that character's mission chain, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Follow Randy's missions to their end and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Contact finales unlock as you finish that character's mission chain, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Follow Tyrone's missions to their end and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Lucia's balcony meditation spot is only available in Chapter 1 and disappears after that chapter. There is no mission replay, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy early reports flag as missable: Lucia's balcony meditation spot is only available in Chapter 1 and disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay — so meditate at the balcony before you finish Chapter 1, then sweep the other 17 spots as you explore. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Track it in the wild — look for its signs, approach quietly, and take a clean shot. The animal is unique, so if you scare it off, leave the area and come back rather than chasing it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, so track which sets you are close on and hunt the missing cards first. Any three finished sets count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the game's photo and spot check-in across Leonida. Any 100 distinct locations count, so do it whenever you reach somewhere new rather than saving it for a grind at the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and they tick over as you play — check the challenges list regularly and steer toward the ones you are closest to finishing. Many complete themselves while you chase other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and lay low until it clears — hiding in alleys and switching vehicles helps you drop the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route past three close shops, hit them one after another, and do not let the wanted level drop to zero between them — that is the run-killer. Keep a getaway car ready before the first robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in or drive 100 distinct models across Leonida. Variety matters, not repeats: try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass, and check the vehicle list to see which classes you are missing.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a tight group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when they cluster, and chain the shots — pick a busy shootout rather than a quiet one, and do not waste the focus on one or two targets.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the Vice City International Airport. Get to the airfield, take an aircraft, and leave without a flight plan or clearance: the trophy is about leaving on your own terms, not about buying a ticket.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks — get into a Rhino, or take one on, and the trophy follows the chaos. The description is a joke about the heat of it, so expect a fight: bring heavy weapons and a plan to escape once it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; only a clean run counts.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan each one: a fast car outside, a quick route in and out, and enough distance before the wanted level peaks. All five vaults count separately, so you can do them across sessions.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. Trucks run routes around the state, so watch the roads for one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive every road, visit every district, and check the map for the areas still unvisited. Fast travel does not count as exploring; you have to pass through.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang holds its own turf and operations — find one operation per gang, hit it, and move on. Keep count of which gangs you have done so none is missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy should pop when the scene triggers. Early reports list this one as having no confirmed unlock method yet, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try another spot along the beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. Early reports list this one as having no confirmed unlock method yet, so if a first attempt does not trigger it, try a different showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. You do not have to win or score high — a completed game is what counts — so play a full game and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is about a partnership moment with mass appeal — a shared achievement with your partner that lands in front of a crowd. Keep playing the story and side content with your partner; partnership moments trigger as you go, and this one pops when the big one lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Choices come up constantly in missions and free roam, so play naturally and the count climbs; there is no single right answer to hunt for.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then pull it off on the immediate retry. Early reports list this one as having no confirmed unlock method yet; the natural reading is a second-attempt success, so when something goes wrong, retry at once instead of reloading an old save.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a scripted oddity somewhere in Leonida. These moments are one-offs you stumble into while exploring, so keep an eye out in odd places and off the beaten track. Early reports list this one as having no confirmed unlock method yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Early reports list this one as having no confirmed unlock method yet; the natural reading is a drive-by hit with a bat or similar while passing at speed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to wash them, and the total adds up across the whole game. Bank and shop robberies are the steadiest supply.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, car mods and food all count, so spend as you play instead of saving it for the end — the total is cumulative across every shop in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages come up for sale as you explore and earn — buy each one when it appears, and check the property list for any you have not bought yet.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 distinct vehicles count — register the ones you drive most, and use the app whenever you pick up something new.
